links.outcome: Usability (System Usability Scale) and completion time among surgeons, anaesthesiologists, and haematologists using case vignettes
links.effect: 86 clinicians assessed the tool; median completion time 72 s (IQR 49·0-79·5); median SUS score 82·5 (IQR 72·5-90·0), indicating excellent usability.
links.quote: The median SUS score was 82·5 (IQR 72·5-90·0), indicating excellent usability.

unlisted_practices: Using a stakeholder focus group to select candidate predictors that are available at pre-anaesthesia evaluation
Explainable/interpretable model design for preoperative prediction

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively validates a predictive risk model (MBD-Check) and evaluates clinician usability via a vignette-based survey with the System Usability Scale. It does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
